camel_example: aliyun agentcore POST /workspaces/ws-2f5f9c5a8d0e4c3b/memorystores/customer-memory/memories --region cn-hangzhou --header "Content-Type=application/x-www-form-urlencoded" --body 'body={metadata={key=hiking}, referenceTime=2023-05-08T13:56:00+08:00, scope={agentId=agent-001, sessionId=session-001, userId=user-001}, messages=[{role=user, content=用户喜欢徒步旅行。}], text=用户喜欢徒步旅行。, sync=true}' --version 2026-08-04 --force
description_en: Writes messages or text to a memory store. By default, sync is set to true, which means the operation synchronously waits for extraction and returns only memories (an empty array is allowed). If sync is set to false, the operation returns only a taskId, which you can query by calling GetMemoryTask
description_zh: 向记忆空间写入消息或文本。sync 缺省为 true，同步等待抽取并仅返回 memories（允许空数组）；sync=false 仅返回 taskId，通过 GetMemoryTask 查询
kebab_example: aliyun agentcore add-memories --workspace-id ws-2f5f9c5a8d0e4c3b --memory-store-name customer-memory --biz-body '{"metadata":{"key":"hiking"},"referenceTime":"2023-05-08T13:56:00+08:00","scope":{"agentId":"agent-001","sessionId":"session-001","userId":"user-001"},"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"用户喜欢徒步旅行。"}],"text":"用户喜欢徒步旅行。","sync":true}' --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddMemories

parameters.help_en: The ID of the AgentCore workspace
parameters.name: workspace_id

fields.help_en: The list of messages. You must provide either this parameter or Text, but not both. The list must contain 1 to 20 messages, and the total size of the content must not exceed 32,000 UTF-8 bytes
fields.help_zh: 消息列表，与 Text 必须且只能提供一个；1～20 条，Content 合计不超过 32000 UTF-8 字节
fields.name: messages

fields.help_en: The string key-value metadata. You can specify up to 16 keys. The maximum length of a key is 64 characters, and the maximum length of a value is 1,024 characters
fields.help_zh: 字符串键值元数据；最多 16 个键，键最长 64 字符，值最长 1024 字符
fields.name: metadata

fields.help_en: The time reference point for the batch of messages or text. The value must be in RFC 3339 format with a time zone and support fractional seconds
fields.help_zh: 本批消息或文本的时间参考点；采用带时区的 RFC 3339 格式并支持小数秒
fields.name: reference_time

fields.help_en: The ID of the agent. The length is limited to 1 to 128 UTF-8 bytes. The ID cannot contain a forward slash (/) or an asterisk (*)
fields.help_zh: Agent ID，长度限制 1 - 128 UTF-8 字节，不允许包含 / 或使用 *
fields.name: agent_id

fields.help_en: The ID of the session. The length is limited to 1 to 128 UTF-8 bytes. The ID cannot contain a forward slash (/) or an asterisk (*)
fields.help_zh: Session ID，长度限制 1 - 128 UTF-8 字节，不允许包含 / 或使用 *
fields.name: session_id

fields.help_en: The ID of the user. The length is limited to 1 to 128 UTF-8 bytes. The ID cannot contain a forward slash (/) or an asterisk (*)
fields.help_zh: 用户 ID，长度限制 1 - 128 UTF-8 字节，不允许包含 / 或使用 *
fields.name: user_id

fields.help_en: The scope of the write operation. UserId, AgentId, and SessionId are all optional
fields.name: scope

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to synchronously wait for memory extraction to complete. Default value: true
fields.help_zh: 是否同步等待记忆抽取完成，缺省为 true
fields.name: sync

fields.help_en: The text to be written directly. You must provide either this parameter or Messages, but not both. The size of the text must not exceed 32,000 UTF-8 bytes
fields.help_zh: 直接写入的文本，与 Messages 必须且只能提供一个；不超过 32000 UTF-8 字节
fields.name: text

parameters.help_en: The request body for writing to memory
parameters.name: body

data.description_en: The result of the write operation

memories.description_en: The memory references returned only when sync is set to true. An empty array is allowed. This parameter is not returned together with taskId
memories.description_zh: 仅 sync=true 返回的记忆引用，允许空数组；不与 taskId 同时返回

memoryId.description_en: The ID of the long-term memory

memories.title_en: 仅 sync=true 返回的记忆引用，允许空数组；不与 taskId 同时返回
memories.title_zh: 仅 sync=true 返回的记忆引用，允许空数组；不与 taskId 同时返回

taskId.description_en: The ID of the task returned only when sync is set to false. This parameter is not returned together with memories
taskId.description_zh: 仅 sync=false 返回的任务 ID；不与 memories 同时返回
taskId.title_en: 仅 sync=false 返回的任务 ID；不与 memories 同时返回
taskId.title_zh: 仅 sync=false 返回的任务 ID；不与 memories 同时返回

success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful
